description: Election Commission - G. M. D. Perera was Selected as the Member of the Bandaragama P.S.
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Bandaragama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election-related matters.
